intended_behavior_phases: Phase 1: Descent and stabilization - reduce vertical speed, center horizontally over pad, maintain upright orientation.
Phase 2: Final approach - fine-tune position and velocity to land softly on pad with both legs contacting simultaneously.
Phase 3: Landing - zero velocity, upright, both legs on ground, terminate with success.

component_scale_reasoning.objective_success_bonus: Large positive reward (+100) for achieving a successful landing (both legs contact, near-zero velocity, upright, near pad). This provides a clear goal signal.
component_scale_reasoning.progress_shaping: Moderate negative reward for distance to pad (-0.1 per unit distance) and vertical speed (-0.1 per unit speed) to guide the lander toward the pad and slow descent. These are reachable intermediate goals.
component_scale_reasoning.mild_regularizers: Small penalties for fuel usage (main engine: -0.03 per unit power, side engines: -0.01 per unit power) to encourage efficiency without discouraging necessary engine use. Small penalty for angle deviation (-0.02 per radian) to encourage upright posture.
component_scale_reasoning.crash_penalty: Strong negative reward (-100) for crashing (terminated without success) to discourage failure.
component_scale_reasoning.diagnostics: Track individual components for monitoring: distance_to_pad, vertical_speed, angle, fuel_usage, success_flag, crash_flag.

component_interaction_check: The shaping terms (distance, vertical speed) guide the lander toward the pad and slow descent, while the success bonus provides a strong terminal signal. The mild regularizers (fuel, angle) do not conflict with the shaping; they encourage efficient and stable flight. The crash penalty is separate and only activates on failure.
